provenance.lastRebaseline: The run now seals a signed model-start census manifest into the run root, so the typed artifact graph gained state/replay/<pr>/model-start-census.manifest.json. Every field of that manifest that is derived from run-specific bytes - the accounting log digest, the preview leaf names and digests, and the run-root identity - is registered in the semantic normalization contract as a derived operational value, so the graph is deterministic across repeated runs. The orchestration decision the oracle asserts below is unchanged.
